DescriptionMoveFiles: Move the selected files and directories to be under the destination directory within the current container. If a file with same name at the destination already exists, that file will be overwritten. The destination directory must already exist. The access control list of the moved files and directories will be preserved.
ErrorFolderNameEmpty: Folder name must not be empty.
ErrorFolderNameEndsWithDot: Folder name must not end with .
ErrorMoveSameDirectory: Destination directory cannot be the source directory.
ErrorNameNotEmptyNoSlashes: Name must not be empty or contain slashes.
MessageCreateFolderAlreadyExists: A folder with the name '%1$s' already exists.
MessageMoveCompleteWithFailure: Completed moving files in container '%1$s' with errors
MessageMoveFailed: Failed to move files in container '%1$s'

PropagatePathAclRecursivelyFailure: Failed to propagate ACLs of '%1$s', directories changed: %2$s, files changed: %3$s, failures: %4$s.
